title: God Bless The United States Of Aliens
subtitle: A nonhuman-voiced Catholic mass ceremony, an all-seeing eyewitness report, a prescient prophecy.
synopsis: An eighteen-minute non-looping mass ceremony, alternating a church leader's address with a four-voice chorus and the interior monologue of a praying alien — built from a 2024 short story and rendered with synthesized voices, field recordings and cathedral reverb.

Presented as a guest work within Domus Diasporica by Mladen Bundalo, part of the Pavilion of Bosnia and Herzegovina at the 61st International Art Exhibition — La Biennale di Venezia (In Minor Keys, curated by Koyo Kouoh). Commissioned by Sarita Vujković and curated by Isidora Živković, on view at Palazzo Malipiero, San Marco, from 9 May to 22 November 2026.
Co-directed by Chris-Armel Iradukunda (daqhris) and Claude Opus 4.7, and made at Hectolitre, Brussels, during the Built with Opus 4.7 hackathon with support from Anthropic (500 USD of API tokens).
